page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr6.20xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 80 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8269CY processors running at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The instance is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 9.6 GB per vCPU.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. It also lacks dedicated GPU hardware accelerators. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 25 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers between cloud resources.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.hfr6.20xlarge offers high memory density per dedicated vCPU, making it suitable for workloads that require large in-memory datasets without the overhead of physical hardware management. Appropriate workloads include large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning systems, heavy data processing pipelines, and memory-intensive analytics applications.
